code:
method: grid
parameters:
  learning_rate:
    values: [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]
  dropout:
    values: [0.1, 0.3, 0.5]

caption: Adding dimensions multiplies the run count; a wasted dimension still gets full coverage.

code:
method: bayes
metric:
  name: val_loss
  goal: minimize
parameters:
  learning_rate:
    distribution: log_uniform_values
    min: 0.00001
    max: 0.01
caption: Each new suggestion depends on prior results -- great for expensive runs, bad for parallelism.

subtitle: What a tracking backend actually needs to store and serve as a sweep scales to hundreds of runs.
